name: The Royal Park Hotel Iconic Tokyo Shiodome
accessSummary: Shimbashi Station (JR Shiodome Exit / Toei Asakusa Line): about 3 min walk / Shimbashi Station (Tokyo Metro Ginza Line): about 5 min walk / Shiodome Station (Toei Oedo Line): about 1 min walk / Shiodome Station (Yurikamome, West Exit): about 1 min walk
hours: The Sky Meeting Plan (26F meeting rooms) is available within business hours of 9:00-21:00, and includes setup time.

rooms.note: Seated buffet: 100 people. These figures are from the hotel's official page. The fact sheet (as of January 2025) gives 110 for seated buffet, 135 for classroom and 210 for theater, so its figures differ from the page.

rooms.name: 25F Shiosai B

rooms.name: 26F Meeting Room AB
rooms.note: Maximum capacity: 10 people. The official table combines A and B in one row (there are 4 meeting rooms in total).

ops.parking: The public parking lot in the hotel basement (B3-B4F) has 192 spaces (hotel fact sheet, as of January 2025). Advance reservations are not accepted. Vehicles up to 5.3 m long, up to 1.95 m wide and up to 1.55-2.1 m high can be accommodated. Banquet hall users get up to 3 hours free and meeting room users get up to 2 hours free; extensions cost 300 yen (tax included) per 20 minutes. For parking inquiries, contact the parking management office (080-5781-5994).
ops.waitingRooms: The four meeting rooms on the 26F (A and B: 26.3㎡ for 10 people, D: 36.3㎡ for 12 people, E: 40.6㎡ for 15 people) are introduced as usable for meetings, waiting rooms and the like. The Sky Meeting Plan is for 6 to 15 people and costs 10,000 yen per person (4 hours) / 13,000 yen (with lunch, 6 hours) / 15,000 yen (with lunch, 8 hours), including tax and service charge; the plan period is April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027. This plan is for meetings and discussions only, and a specific room cannot be requested. A 50-inch monitor and Wi-Fi are free; a projector (16,500 yen), a screen (5,500 yen) and a whiteboard (3,300 yen) are charged. (Sky Meeting Plan Guide, April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027)
ops.restaurants: The hotel has 4 restaurants and bars: on the 24F, All-Day Dining "HARMONY" (80 seats; private rooms for 6 to 14) and Bar & Lounge "THE BAR" (46 seats); on the 25F, Japanese Cuisine "Oshima Shinbashi Shiodome branch" (96 seats; 5 private rooms for 4 to 18); and on the 1F, Cafe "CHAYA Macrobiotics" (70 seats). The official FAQ says restaurants can be reserved for private use, after-parties and parties (inquire with the restaurant). The party plans for the banquet hall "Shiosai" are buffet style (from 20 people; 13,000 / 15,000 / 18,000 yen) and formal dinner style (from 10 people; 15,000 / 18,000 / 25,000 yen); both include 2 hours of free drinks, and the price includes food, drinks, venue fee, tax and service charge (April 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027; the 13,000 yen buffet is not available from December 1, 2026 to January 31, 2027; buffet time extension is 1,300 yen per person per 30 minutes).
